obligations.property: Every accepted slice, sector conversion, count*record-size and offset+len is representable and within the admitted parent range; every rejected input has no dereference/allocation based on invalid geometry.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Kani full u64 operands; arbitrary 0..64-byte buffer windows and 0..8 records; unwind assertions; header/trailer buffers tested at exact format length.
obligations.negative_witness: offset near MAX + length wraps into valid looking offset

obligations.property: Each supported map resolves exactly one data or declared zero source per admitted sector; physical compressed spans stay in data fork; run order, comments, terminal rules and checked lengths agree with profile.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Only fixture-qualified UDIF profiles; finite 0..8 runs and 0..16 sectors; zero/ignore semantics must be established by independent ledger, not an assumption that they are interchangeable.
obligations.negative_witness: gap or overlap hidden by sorted index; ignore run treated as stored zero bytes

obligations.property: Stream segmentation does not alter CRC in a single qualified domain; stored digests cover the precise required bytes; a checksum mismatch is never accepted as verified.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: CRC library contract tested with independent known vectors; compare all qualified checksum domains and zero/ignore cases to native fixtures.
obligations.negative_witness: valid table CRC but wrong data-fork checksum accepted

obligations.target: dmgez-udif / indexed reads and bounded decoder
obligations.property: A request for admitted [a,b) returns exact concatenation of decoded runs or an error; decoded lengths and budget checked before accepting output; unknown run never yields synthetic zeros.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Qualified codec contracts; small runs <=8 and range partitions; independent arbitrary byte stream, decoder budget including hostile lengths.
obligations.negative_witness: last partial read crosses block boundary and returns data from adjacent block

obligations.property: Accepted manifest has unique normalized sibling names, no escape, correct link kinds and stable generated identities; strict packaging rejects any required unavailable/unsupported metadata rather than guessing.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Filesystem owns canonical equality; host snapshot/identity contracts not absolute concurrency guarantees; generated trees up to 12 nodes plus larger randomized/native cases.
obligations.negative_witness: two Unicode equivalent paths silently overwrite; background alias stale CNID

obligations.target: dmgez-builder / stage and commit state machine
obligations.property: Only a complete validated staged image can be published; any earlier failure leaves previous target intact or absent; no source or unrelated file overwritten; stream failure is reported invalid.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Atomic no-clobber/replace contract of supported host FS; model finite two writers, one cancel, each stage and crash; durability separate from atomic visibility.
obligations.negative_witness: ENOSPC after stage; competing builder wins no-clobber race

obligations.property: Each admitted run owns one bounded credit reservation, written at most once in ordinal order; failure cancels and releases credits exactly once; no partial success.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: TLC <=4 jobs/3 workers, <=4 credits plus fail/cancel/slow head; Loom equivalent small synchronization model/actual instrumented coordinator; fairness for liveness only with runnable workers and responsive sink.
obligations.negative_witness: head job slow, later jobs fill queue, consumer blocked waiting on worker-held resource

obligations.property: Given same canonical sector source, options, deterministic codec and metadata, every completed worker permutation has identical emitted sequence and same unsigned bytes as serial.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Lean proof for pure ordering/refinement linked via extraction; external encoder determinism is an assumption checked on pinned versions; native cross-host fixtures.
obligations.negative_witness: worker completion order controls offsets or plist order

obligations.target: dmgez-vfs / bounded source, namespace and checks
obligations.property: Every subvolume read maps inside authorized immutable image range, selected volume; full verification pass iff all required checks pass; partial/unknown/unsupported not promoted to valid.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Kani full-width arithmetic, nested windows depth <=4, symbolic status combinations; native multi-volume fixtures.
obligations.negative_witness: partition offset + relative extent escapes selected partition; unsupported checksum treated as valid

obligations.target: dmgez-operations / extraction path admission and publish
obligations.property: No extraction side effect outside authorized destination root or authorized replace; path validation rejects ambiguous/reserved names; symlinks not followed for writing; per-item failures accurately reported.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Kani pure path grammar bounded 0..8 components; handle-based host adapters, reparse rules and actual races tested per OS; lexical proof not host security proof.
obligations.negative_witness: attacker swaps parent directory for symlink between validation and write

obligations.target: dmgez-config / command model and dmgez-preview / geometry
obligations.property: Apply/undo/redo restores semantic project state; preview reads actual selected image and does not mount/execute; all coordinate transforms are finite and invertible where defined.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Pure commands <=20 operations reference model; native icon/view differences allowed explicitly.
obligations.negative_witness: undo changes path identity or hidden flags; malicious preview triggers open/execute

obligations.property: No sign/notary/staple/publication unless authorized stage preconditions and correct artifact identity hold; stale submission/digest or pending/rejected outcome cannot mark ready.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: TLC <=2 artifact revisions/2 submissions, ambiguous upload failure, accepted/rejected/cancel; native Apple service treated as external, actual acceptance independent.
obligations.negative_witness: reuse prior accepted ticket for modified file; retry ambiguous upload blindly

obligations.target: dmgez-operations + dmgez-cache / overlay and cache key
obligations.property: No-op overlay preserves all claimed metadata/logical data; untouched entries remain unchanged; cache hit only for exact logical bytes/profile and verified decoded length/digest; cache cannot silently corrupt image.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Reference small image <=16 entries, <=8 runs; cryptographic hash assumption explicit, cache treated hostile; exact comparison in tests.
obligations.negative_witness: cached block for same offset but different compression/profile is reused

obligations.property: Only managed mount identity may be unmounted; auto-eject requires observed intended fresh copy, verified destination and no outstanding writes under defined completion policy; stale event/old matching app never sufficient.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: TLC finite 2 mounts, 2 apps, 2 destination revisions, event loss/reorder/busy/cancel; host completion evidence not guaranteed by notifications; normal OS unmount may refuse.
obligations.negative_witness: pre-existing identical app or delayed event causes premature eject

obligations.target: dmgez remote storage adapter + MCP service / approval state
obligations.property: Every range read uses same admitted resource identity and exact checked offsets; side effects require matching authorization, path scope and current request identity; redirect/changed resource/approval invalidates state.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: TLC two resources/revisions and approvals, timeout/redirect; strong validator or full snapshot; actual HTTP and OS contracts tested.
obligations.negative_witness: server swaps ETag between trailer and block reads; stale approval permits different output

obligations.target: dmgez-udif / pure checked interval and lookup helpers
obligations.property: For all representable offsets and validated run-map sizes, Rust range-map lookup refines mathematical partition of logical domain; out-of-domain requests error; concatenated reads equal whole reads.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Lean spec over naturals, extraction of actual safe Rust helpers; codecs/external I/O treated as tested contracts; no unbounded proof of parser or OS.
obligations.negative_witness: off-by-one at terminal sector or width conversion

obligations.property: Advertised default closure excludes forbidden runtime categories; no cycles, app dependencies or cross-repo reverse dependency; required evidence matches profile, source and toolchain.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: All implemented target feature combos and pinned metadata; negative test graph mutations; optional signing transitive exception explicit.
obligations.negative_witness: test-only oracle leaks into normal dependency graph

obligations.property: No unqualified advanced profile accepted for writes; bounds and security contract per envelope/segment/band; encryption auth status honest; writable mounts preserve independent transaction gates.
obligations.assumptions_and_initial_bounds: Separate threat model, legal fixture and per-variant obligation additions required before activation; no claims about unimplemented formats.
obligations.negative_witness: unknown mandatory flag ignored, segment path escapes root or invalid tag reported valid
